snippet.title: Eldritch House Trailer
snippet.description:
Eldritch House is a first person narrative adventure presented in a 3D comic book style. Players are tasked with investigating the disappearance of a young woman and the supernatural occurrences at Blake Manor, a remote hotel in the West of Ireland. Can you unearth its secrets?


WISHLIST - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395520/Eldritch_House/
WEBSITE - https://www.spookydoorway.com
